fields.name: Integration Collar – Phoenix (Stainless)
fields.short_description: The Integration Collar enhances the aesthetic of heaters installed into a bench, giving them a seamless, built-in look. The collars are built from various materials, carefully chosen to complement a sauna room's design. Options include sleek, hairline-finish stainless steel, natural soft soapstone, and durable laminated wood.
